newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon air cargo up 10.4pct in Dec, 1.5pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo up 10.4pct in Dec, 1.5pct in 1996.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 10.4 percent in December to 9,263 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said.
Cargo handled in 1996 totalled 100,812 tonnes, up 1.5 percent on 1995.
Passenger numbers were 1.5 percent higher than the same month a 1995 at 436,380, an increase of 2.2 percent for the year as a whole to 6.38 million.
The number of aircraft movements rose by 5.1 percent in the month to 6,416 and by 3.6 percent in the year to 79,876.

Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up nearly 39 percent in December at 2,882 tonnes, taking Porto's accumulated 1996 total to 26,879 tonnes, 9.3 percent higher than 1995. Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax 5017
